title: ZeRO3 builds fp16 partitions from full param_groups including frozen params, OOM-equivalent silent waste plus unused optimizer state
root_cause: DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3._setup_for_real_optimizer called _create_fp16_partitions_with_defragmentation() on the raw self.optimizer.param_groups, including frozen params. Frozen params became part of the partitioned trainable list — they were placed into Adam fp32 state and received update increments from optimizer.step, silently un-freezing them.
invariant: Across optimizer steps, p.data must remain unchanged for every nn.Parameter with requires_grad=False.
diff_summary: Add _get_trainable_parameter_groups() that filters by requires_grad and pass the filtered list into _create_fp16_partitions_with_defragmentation.
